findings.description: With a recognised prefix, the loop still removes other type labels added by hand (a `test` label on a `fix:` PR is removed on every `synchronize`). Lines 2-3 promise that "labels a person adds by hand stay", which is only true when the title has no prefix. Either the comment overstates the guarantee, or the one-type-label rule should be stated there.

When an `edited` event takes a recognised prefix off the title (e.g. `fix: x` becomes `Fix x`), the type label the bot added earlier now stays for good. The script cannot tell bot-added labels from hand-added ones, and the line 47 comment only describes the hand-added case. This is the intended trade-off, but nothing documents that an outdated label survives.

`have` comes from the event payload, not a fresh `listLabelsOnIssue`. If the label was removed by hand after the event, or by a concurrent run (the workflow has no `concurrency` group, so `edited` and `synchronize` can overlap), `removeLabel` gets a 404 and the job fails. A try/catch that ignores 404, or a `concurrency` group keyed on the PR number, would fix it.

The match is case-sensitive, so `Fix:` or `Feat(core):` get no type label. Many titles in this repo are plain sentences ("Add the intent.md stage...", "Test that a stale listing..."), and on those the script now correctly does nothing.

process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. So git diff, gh pr diff/view and git show were all unavailable. Nobody could read the delta 2760a8f..HEAD. The reviewers only saw the final state of .github/workflows/labeler.yml, and they inferred the delta from the commit message f88478f.

The prior record records/42264635477.json could not be read (git show failed), so its important findings could not be checked and prior_importants is empty because nothing was checked, not because nothing was found. The second freshness assertion (HEAD vs headRefOid) could not run, and PR comments/reviews were not read for steering. Only correctness and context ran, gated on a delta that looked CI-only. Their gating was inferred and not checked against a diff, so treat this round as partial and re-run.
